channel.title: The Traitors
channel.desc: Following a sleepless night, the players arrive at breakfast eager to share their latest thoughts on the Traitors' gameplay. With a mission focused on protection from murder, true intentions are laid bare. A fractious Round Table causes the game to heat up, and repercussions of the latest banishment create new suspicions - but can the Traitors keep control?
